observations.B01: Initial compressed phrase is uncertain; the first word appears abbreviated. The quotes and explicit tri-angles hyphen are visible, as is the end-of-line corres- continuation. Capital I has serifs rather than a separate overbar.
observations.B02: The comparison mark has a wavy upper stroke and a lower bar. Plural termination of paire(s) is unresolved. The two figures 1 and 5 are distinct. The abbreviation icos. and line-end ordi- are retained; upper-edge neighboring descender excluded.
observations.B03: The ordered pattern reads 2,2,1 with commas. Qu’on peut interpréter and quatre are legible; the compact word carrées is read from its repeated r strokes. Neighboring line fragments at the top excluded.
observations.B04: Five is an Arabic numeral. The abbreviated point word is retained as pts; the final capital is serif I.
observations.B05: Four heavy vertex dots define an irregular quadrilateral. Smaller dark pips occur on top and bottom sides; a small irregular isolated mark lies to the right and is rendered as a dot, although its lobed shape could be letterlike. No label is secure.
observations.B06: The complete main-text parenthesis has tel carré, deux paires, diagonalement opposés. The next clause has 15 arêtes and dudit. Slanting marginal fragments are excluded because they belong to B07.
observations.B07: Fresh crop rotated 35 degrees clockwise for the slanted note. Jeu versus jeux is unresolved. The en and the crossed word following deux paires are uncertain; dense neighboring main-text strokes complicate their scope. The separate f and a labels are placed according to their positions in the triangular portion and beside the divider. Main-text fragments at right and below excluded. Sketch has four outside segments and one top-to-bottom divider, with no arrowheads.
observations.B08: Small a sits above an insertion caret after côté. Dans is struck. Parenthesized incident is written above and singly underlined; the wider curved insertion guide is not counted as another underline. Upper and lower edge fragments excluded.
observations.B09: Multiple layers retained independently. A high crossing stroke passes over deux, with l’un de/l’une des above; its exact attachment remains uncertain. A short struck cot-like fragment precedes sommets. Opposés is written above the longer struck word read tentatively as consécutifs. The i.e. clause occupies an inserted interline, while On voit donc is cancelled by a long horizontal stroke. Final main-text line entering at bottom is excluded and read under B10.
observations.B10: Donc on voit que is placed at the left with a curved insertion guide leading into la relation. The line continues d’incidence des diviseurs, then à sommets de la structure. The M has a separate caret above and subscript 0,5. Upper-edge prior insertion fragments and lower-edge next-line fragments excluded.
observations.B11: Faces et arêtes, gauche, and ou par dualité are readable. The upper-edge residue from à sommets and lower-edge replacement word belong to neighboring boxes and are excluded.
observations.B12: Arêtes on the baseline is struck and sommets is supplied above. Faces is crossed by a long stroke and arêtes supplied above. Final word reads dodécaèdre. Upper-edge preceding-line fragments excluded.
observations.B13: Two pencilled sixes have closed lower loops and open upper hooks; recorded as manuscript foliation 66.
